title: Homology of the localized canonical cycle map
statement: Let C be an abelian category with derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], K a cochain complex and n any integer. Define the chain map cycles_n(K)[-n] \to K by the canonical cycle inclusion in degree n and zero elsewhere, and define its derived map using singleFunctorIsoCompQ and Q. The inverse specified single/homology comparison followed by the degree-n homology of this map equals homologyπ(K,n) followed by the inverse localization/homology factor isomorphism at K.

source.place: 05TC (2), canonical double truncation; 05TD (3), actual derived unit. Canonical-map calculation written by R2 from the parent node and the named library comparisons.

proof.text: Construct the chain map using mkHomFromSingle and iCycles_d. Expand the derived single/homology comparison; its single/localization factor is the identity. Apply naturality of the inverse localization/homology factor isomorphism.

Precompose with the invertible single/cycles identification. Use single/cycles/homology compatibility and homologyπ naturality. The induced cycles map is the single/cycles identification: composing both with the monic cycle inclusion reduces this to the sole component of mkHomFromSingle. Cancel the isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem cyclesDerivedMap_homology (n : ℤ) (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) :
    (singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso C n).inv.app ((K.sc n).cycles) ≫
      (homologyFunctor C n).map (cyclesDerivedMap n K) =
    (K.sc n).homologyπ ≫ (homologyFunctorFactors C n).inv.app K
